scenes.say: Same meal, same food. But the order you eat it in could change your blood sugar.
scenes.headline: SAME MEAL. DIFFERENT ORDER.

scenes.say: Try this. Eat your veggies and protein first, and save the carbs for last.
scenes.headline: THE ORDER

scenes.say: In a small Weill Cornell study, eleven adults with type two diabetes ate the same meal two ways.
scenes.headline: THE STUDY

scenes.say: When veggies and protein came first, blood sugar was about thirty seven percent lower at one hour, and seventeen percent at two hours.
scenes.headline: BLOOD SUGAR LOWER BY

scenes.say: So don't start with the bread basket. Start with the salad.
scenes.headline: FIRST BITE SWAP

scenes.say: Carbs last still counts. Portions still matter, and the study was small.
scenes.headline: CARBS STILL COUNT

scenes.say: Easy one for your Thanksgiving plate. Turkey and veggies first, stuffing and rolls last.
scenes.headline: TRY IT THIS THURSDAY

scenes.say: What do you usually eat first? Comment below, and follow for more.
scenes.headline: WHAT DO YOU EAT FIRST?
